query:
SELECT ua.id, ua.appUserId, ua.actionType, ua.feature, ua.createdAt, au.email
FROM user_actions ua
JOIN app_users au ON ua.appUserId = au.id
WHERE au.email = 'oren263@gmail.com'
ORDER BY ua.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 10;
